blocks.text: The western basalt plains grasslands are one of Australia's most threatened ecosystems. Iramoo Wildflower Grassland is a remnant of this ancient landscape — a living archive of plants, soils and stories that have shaped this Country for millennia.

Iramoo holds more than 200 indigenous plant species, including rare wildflowers, native grasses and ground orchids found nowhere else in the region. Each season brings a different bloom, a different story.

Kangaroo Grass (Themeda triandra)
Spiny Rice-flower (Pimelea spinescens)
Button Wrinklewort (Rutidosis leptorrhynchoides)
Matted Flax-lily (Dianella amoena)
Golden Sun Moth (Synemon plana)
